verdicts.reason: Both fail in the same ways. The photo has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail pushed to the right edge, and a pink corner triangle cuts across the model's face. The text bars are in the wrong order, with Photography first and LomoArt second, so the 'LomoArt Fashion Photography' brand line is jumbled. Large black dead areas surround a small, scattered cluster of content. B gets the slight edge only because its content sits closer to the vertical centre; A leaves about 215px of empty black at the bottom.
